profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Granular
profile.summary:
A seasoned software development professional with extensive experience in the full lifecycle of software development, primarily in a technical lead or architect role. I am committed to helping development teams succeed by promoting an atmosphere of shared responsibility, respect, camaraderie, and constant learning.

As such, I am comfortable in either a "pure" development role, or in combination with process/organizational issues.  I particularly enjoy passing on hard-won knowledge for the enrichment of other team members and the team as a whole. Apart from delivering working software on time and under budget, I tend to pay particular attention to maintainability, clean code, continuous integration, and maintaining an agile development culture.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior software development role for CiBO's agricultural simulation platform. The position involved working closely with experts in agronomy and data science to deliver solutions for CiBO's suite of crop simulation and analysis products, and adapting to ever-changing business conditions in a fast-growing startup. Highlights include:
* Writing software for ingestion and analysis of remote sensing data and make it available for analysis via a convenient API
* Extensive coding in Scala
* Bayesian data modeling
* Design of REST APIs and creation of cloud-hosted REST services
* Performance optimization
* Mentoring of more junior developers
* Formal and informal instructional presentations to coworkers
* Facilitation of book study groups for professional development

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description: Standard Register was purchased by the Taylor Corporation in 2015 and became Taylor Communications.

positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
When Dialog Medical was acquired by Standard Register in 2011, my role expanded to include technology oversight over the combined suite of software products offered by the Standard Register Healthcare business unit. I spent a lot of time in the last couple of years working to integrate what was now a geographically-disperse development team, adopting tools and best practices from both offices. Aside from product-focused architecture, design and development work, much of my focus is on nonfunctional aspects of the software such as security, performance, maintainability, deployment, and DevOps.

Highlights of my tenure at Standard Register include the following:

Architecture and design of a multitenant, cloud-hosted platform to support the next generation of healthcare products

Design and implementation of a middleware component with a consistent, REST API to facilitate communication between new or external applications and existing legacy services running within a hospital firewall

Led the effort to improve application security for new and legacy applications

Led the effort to achive ONCHIT Privacy and Security certification for iMedConsent

Have pushed continually toward better continuous integration and deployment

positions.title: Software Architect
positions.description:
Senior technical person involved in the requirements gathering, design, development, testing, operations, and support of iMedConsent, a software system used by healthcare providers to provide informed consent, patient education and other patient documents and to facilitate communications between physicians and patients. The software is used in hundreds of hospitals and thousands of physician practices and integrates with a hospital's electronic health record (EHR) system.

Over my tenure there I worked on most parts of the system, designing and implementing features, troubleshooting and fixing problems, and refactoring legacy code, bringing a continual emphasis on code quality, and automated build, testing and deployment processes to the development group, working closely with all stakeholders to refine requirements and acceptance criteria. I conducted code reviews, led developer learning sessions, and participated in developer interviews and orientation of new hires.

Highlights of work include the following:

Replacement of ActiveX-based web plugin product with a true web-based product, which greatly simplified upgrades, providing significant cost savings to clients and in the development and testing process

Design and implementation of import/export processes and file interchange format for informed consent procedure information and other content, replacing the previous system which was strongly tied to the internal database schema and particular version of the software. This hugely simplified the process of delivering new content and content updates to customers, and enables clients to receive updates to the content automatically via an RSS feed.

Design and implementation of a fast, full-text search capability for content within the application using Lucene.NET

Spearheaded many enhancements to internal build and update processes, including an automation of configuration changes during product upgrades, leading to significant time savings and error reduction

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description: Provided software architecture and development services for the Entertainment group within Radiant Systems. Performed end-to-end design, development, and maintenance of a multithreaded, transactional ticketing server for large movie theatres.  The server handles walk-up and Will Call ticket sales for both general admission and reserved seating situations.  It is written in C# and employs SQL Server as a back-end database.  Installations have been running in multiple sites across the country since July 2003.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description:
Provided system architecture and development services for the Radiant Systems Lodging Services Solution, an Application Service Provider enabling hoteliers to run and manage hotels through a web browser.  The service ran at over 100 properties and employed Java 2, Enterprise Edition (J2EE) technology. Primarily responsible for the design and development of the room availability, accounting, and rate management modules. Contributed to the design and development of many additional features. Worked continuously to improve performance, scalability and maintainability of the system. Conducted code reviews and performed other mentoring tasks with other developers.

Radiant Systems (see above) purchased the assets of HotelTools in July 2001. I continued to work on this system at Radiant Systems until April 2002.

positions.title: Software Development Consultant
positions.description: Performed application development, project management, business analysis, content management, and website maintenance services for an e-commerce firm providing employee benefits and retail financial services over the World Wide Web.  Technologies include UNIX-based Apache web servers and Oracle databases, with CGI applications written in C, C++ and Perl.

positions.title: Manager
positions.description: Same as previous. inter.logic.studios was acquired by USWeb in March 1998.

positions.title: Director of Applications Development
positions.description: Technical lead for several sophisticated public and intranet web applications. Responsible for management of software developers designing and implementing database-backed web sites. Intensive use of Microsoft Internet Information Server (IIS), Active Server Pages (ASP), server components written in Visual Basic 5, and SQL Server databases.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and developed server process software for data-driven websites. Designed and implemented databases for dynamic web content. Developed companion sites for remote administration of dynamic content. Technologies used included O'Reilly Web server and Microsoft Internet Information Server, CGI-Win and Visual Basic 4, Java, and Microsoft Access.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in all facets of commercial software development. Primary duties included design and development of software written in C for satellite image processing, cartography, and geographic information systems (GIS) on UNIX-based workstations. Secondary duties included testing, documentation, training and user support.
